column4: This publication describes the 7030 Master Control
Program (MCP) loader and the FORTRAN Binary and
loader is capable of processing relocatable or abso-
lute binary decks. The BSS processor allocates storage,
calls subprograms from the FORTRAN library, and
completes subprogram cross references. A segmen-
tation program, which provides a method of storage
overlay, is included in the BSS processor.
